Have questions?

We’ve got the answers

What happens after I submit my application?

Our recruitment team will assess your qualifications and experience against the role's requirements. If shortlisted, we will contact you for an initial screening call or interview. If not selected, you will receive an email notification.

I have all the qualifications listed, but I wasn’t offered an interview, why?

While meeting the listed qualifications is important, interview decisions also depend on factors like application volume, candidate pool competitiveness, or specific needs such as relevant project experience or specialized skills. We review every application thoroughly but cannot interview all applicants. We encourage you to apply for future positions that match your expertise and stay in touch with our team.

What should I expect in the hiring process?

Our interview process is thorough and role-specific, involving:

  • Initial Screening Call: A discussion with a recruiter about your background, career goals, and role suitability.
  • Technical or Role-Specific Assessments: Depending on the role, this includes two to three interviews with potential future managers, which may involve coding challenges, problem-solving exercises, case studies, or task-based assignments.
  • Behavioral Interviews: To understand how you approach challenges, collaborate with teams, and demonstrate key competencies related to the role, review fit, expectations, and long-term potential.

Remote interviews will be conducted using the Riverside platform. Your recruiter will be with you every step of the way, providing support and guidance to make the process meaningful, and positive.

What if I need accommodations throughout the interview process?

We’re happy to provide any necessary accommodations to support you. Simply inform your recruiter or hiring contact, and we’ll ensure a comfortable and inclusive experience. All requests will be handled with care and confidentiality.

Can I apply for multiple positions?

Yes! If you find multiple roles that match your skills and interests, feel free to apply. Our team will review each application and consider your qualifications for all relevant positions.

Does Riverside offer remote work opportunities?

Yes! Many of our roles offer flexibility, including fully remote or hybrid options, depending on the position and location. We embrace a flexible work environment to support collaboration across our global team.
